description: The AWS member accounts Plutus discovered behind the connected organization: how many are readable, unreadable or excluded, and per account the access status, the fix when it is unreadable, and whether it is included. `enabled` false means multi-account inventory is off for this account. Change inclusion with set_aws_member_account_included. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/aws/member-accounts.
name: list_aws_member_accounts
